vulnerabilities.title: Ubiquiti Patches Critical UniFi Flaws Across Connect, Talk, Access, Protect, and OS
vulnerabilities.summary: Ubiquiti a mis à jour ses produits pour corriger des failles critiques dans UniFi Connect, Talk, Access, Protect et OS, potentiellement menaçantes.

vulnerabilities.title: 15-Year-Old GhostLock Flaw Enables Root and Container Escape on Most Linux Distros
vulnerabilities.summary: GhostLock est une vulnérabilité de 15 ans du noyau Linux permettant le vol total des droits root sur la plupart des distributions.

vulnerabilities.title: CISA Adds 4 Actively Exploited Adobe, Joomla, and Langflow Flaws to KEV
vulnerabilities.summary: CISA a ajouté quatre vulnérabilités exploitées activement à sa liste KEV, comprenant Adobe ColdFusion et Joomla.

campaigns.title: New HalluSquatting Attack Could Trick AI Coding Assistants Into Installing Botnet Malware
campaigns.summary: Les assistants IA pourraient être utilisés dans un nouvel attaque appelée HalluSquatting pour installer du malware sur les systèmes des utilisateurs.

campaigns.title: SCMBANKER Malware Uses ClickFix Lures to Target Mexican Banking Users
campaigns.summary: SCMBANKER utilise des pièges ClickFix pour cibler des utilisateurs mexicains de banques et d'échanges cryptomonnaies.

campaigns.title: Taiwan charges two businessmen over alleged role in Chinese espionage campaign
campaigns.summary: A company based in Taiwan was leasing out accounts on the popular LINE messaging app to Chinese spies, according to prosecutors, who charged two men in the alleged scheme.

campaigns.title: Fake Paysafe, Skrill SDKs on NPM and PyPi steal credentials
campaigns.summary: Malicious packages on the Node Package Manager (npm) and the Python Package Index (PyPI) delivered stealer malware to developers and users of Paysafe, Skrill, and Neteller payment applications. [...]

campaigns.title: InTruth veut vérifier les politiques en direct
campaigns.summary: InTruth utilise l’IA pour vérifier en direct les déclarations politiques et limiter l’impact des fausses informations.

campaigns.title: Hackers exploit Roundcube flaw to spy on academic researchers
campaigns.summary: A China-linked threat cluster has been exploiting vulnerable Roundcube servers at U.S. and Canadian universities to steal credentials and deploy backdoor malware. [...]

top_reads.title: Mount Royal University confirms breach as hackers claim attack
top_reads.summary: Mount Royal University in Calgary says hackers stole and then deleted data from its file storage systems after breaching the university's network. [...]

top_reads.title: The Verification Step Is the New ATO Battleground in 2026
top_reads.summary: L'époque des attaques par soufflage de crédenciaux se termine avec l'adoption croissante des passkeys.

top_reads.title: Telco giant KDDI says data breach affects over 12 million people
top_reads.summary: KDDI confirme un vaste incident de fuite de données concernant plus de 12 millions de personnes au Japon.
